 How to Watch Thunder vs Mavericks
 When: Wednesday, October 28, 2026
 Time: 9:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: ESPN, ESPN Deportes
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Oklahoma City remains undefeated after beating the Phoenix Suns 125-114 on Monday for its fourth straight win. Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 30 points, while Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 26 points and Isaiah Hartenstein finished with 15 points and 13 rebounds. Rookie Aday Mara also recorded his first career double-double as the Thunder used a 22-6 second-quarter run to take control. Oklahoma City has continued winning despite several injuries, including Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, who are expected to miss significant time, in addition to Chet Holmgren and Alex Caruso dealing with minor injuries.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Dallas returns home after beating the Miami Heat 113-109 on Monday to even its record at 2-2. Cooper Flagg scored 29 points with 11 assists and added five steals to lead the Mavericks. Flagg has returned from his shoulder injury quickly and continues to be a major part of Dallas' offense, while Kyrie Irving looks to be fully back from his major injury. The Mavericks have won two of their last three games after losing their season opener to Houston, but they'll face a tough test against an Oklahoma City team that has held three of its first four opponents to 114 points or fewer.
